about: Where each part of @origingame/engine-knowledge lands in the platform's production tree (packages/game-knowledge/production): skills as game/skills/<name>/, the style catalogue (looks/) beside og-taste as its looks/, the hand-written guides (guides/: three-to-og) as the og-game skill's guides/, and the project template as one scaffold overlay. The generated API wiki (wiki/) is not mounted: `og api` reads it from the engine package's knowledge/wiki. `@template/` is templates/game in the engine repository and scaffold/template/ (text files, copied at prepack) in the published package.
